_comment: The invoice as rendered by make-fixtures.mjs, keyed by article code so a row read out of order still grades. Totaal = 1782,00 + 759,80 + 411,00 + 167,40 + 85,00 + 500,00 = 3705,20. D-012 is printed at 85,00 against 1 x 95,00 — a discount no arithmetic predicts, so a model that multiplies instead of reading is caught on that cell and on the total. The btw column is the trap: every row is 21 except C-330, which is 9, so a model reading the wrong column has somewhere visible to go wrong.
